text: Security is a crucial part of web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. This protects sensitive information like passwords. Second, authentication ensures that only verified users can access certain areas. Strong passwords and two-factor authentication make this even safer. Third, input validation checks what users type into forms, preventing harmful code from entering your system. Without these steps, websites face common vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting. These attacks can steal data or damage your site. By combining HTTPS, authentication, and input validation, developers build safer applications and protect their users.
